findings.text: a relative --gate-file path passed at submit time resolves to the same file inside the submitted job, and the line that decides it is imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1037 (`f"export {GATE_PATH_ENV}={shlex.quote(str(gate_file))}"`), which embeds the value verbatim with no .resolve(); the same file then follows because nothing changes directory - _sbatch_headers (imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:69-87) sets no --chdir, submit_script (imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1132-1138) runs `sbatch --parsable` from the CLI's own working directory, so sbatch's documented default ('the calling process working directory') makes the job's cwd the submitter's cwd, and resolve_gate_path returns the variable unresolved (imas_ambix/agent/router.py:252-258). Measured in review-relpath.log: `agent router --dry-run --gate-file rel/gate.json` prints `export AMBIX_ROUTER_GATE_PATH=rel/gate.json`. The identity is inherited from sbatch's default rather than pinned by the diff, so a future --chdir in the header (or a submission from another directory) would silently re-point the same string and no test would redden; one line in the generated script resolving the path, or one test with a relative value, would make the property explicit.

a tilde-prefixed --gate-file value is not expanded anywhere and so names a literal `~` directory: click.Path() is declared without resolve_path or expanduser (imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:1731) and Path(gate_file) at :1767 does not expand either, while shlex.quote wraps the value so the job's shell will not expand it - measured, `--gate-file '~/gate.json'` prints `export AMBIX_ROUTER_GATE_PATH='~/gate.json'` (review-relpath.log). A shell user typing an unquoted ~ is protected by their own shell, so this is a quoted-form or scripted-invocation edge inherited from the earlier --gate-file option rather than introduced by this node; it is worth naming because resolve_gate_path honours a path whether or not it exists, so the miss reads as an empty gate rather than as an error.

a job submitted without --gate-file still obeys an inherited AMBIX_ROUTER_GATE_PATH: the body carries no export, but the header sets no --export restriction - the inheritance fact the node's own test now asserts - and resolve_gate_path's environment branch (imas_ambix/agent/router.py:252-258) precedes the lane sibling, so a stale variable exported in the submitting shell steers a no-option submission to a file the generated script never names. That is the 'a value that lives only in an invocation' class section 15 exists to remove, and it follows from the plan's own byte-identity clause (kept and tested), which rules out pinning the resolved path in this change; the deploy step should therefore state that the submitting shell must not carry the variable when submitting without the option, or a later node pins the resolved path into the body.
